summary: Describes a set of private SIP headers used by the 3rd Generation Partnership Project, along with where they apply, which is limited to particular environments. They carry things such as charging data and information about the networks a call crosses. It is informational and was replaced by RFC 7315.

eli5.summary: Mobile phone networks stick extra private notes on call-setup messages, such as who pays and which networks it crossed. This note lists those notes. It was later replaced by RFC 7315.
